description: Maya has her late grandmother's trunk of handwritten family letters and is organizing an afternoon gathering where selected letters will be read and displayed. She must make the final call about the reading list, privacy handling, preservation materials, and reading schedule, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The trunk contains eight labeled letters, including L02, L03, L04, L06, and L07.
shared_context.S2: The family gathering is scheduled for 2026-12-06 from 14:00 to 17:00.
shared_context.S3: Maya is responsible for choosing which letters are read aloud and how the originals are handled during the gathering.
shared_context.S4: The letters will be placed on a display table for guests to see, and some guests may want copies afterward.
shared_context.S5: Before setting up, Maya follows the family's usual practice of checking with each person involved for relevant requests or practical details.

PF1.text: Leo found a handwritten note from Grandmother inside the trunk saying that letter L03 should be read aloud at the family gathering; the note has not reached Maya or the rest of the group.

PF2.text: Noor was told by the living recipient of letter L06 that it must not be read, photographed, or copied; Noor has not yet shared that request with the group.

PF3.text: A paper conservator, Elena Ruiz, advised Ben that the originals should be placed in archival polyester sleeves and displayed without adhesive mounts; Ben has not passed along the recommendation.

PF4.text: Ava already promised Maya's aunt that she would read letter L07 at exactly 15:30 during the gathering; she has not yet put that commitment into the family plan.

settlement_schema.revealed_requirement: For every private fact used in the settlement, populate revealed with the fact_id mapped to the agent_id of the person who said that fact aloud. In particular, if PF1 is revealed by Leo, use {"PF1":"A2"}.

acceptance_conditions: Letter L03 must be included among the selected letters.
Letter L06 must be withheld from reading, photographing, and copying.
The originals must use archival polyester sleeves and no adhesive mounts.
Ava must be scheduled to read letter L07 at exactly 15:30.
A privacy-hold commitment for L06 must be recorded.
An archival-handling commitment must be recorded.
Ava's 15:30 reading commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C2: 'L06' in decisions['privacy_action'] and 'not' in decisions['privacy_action'] and 'read' in decisions['privacy_action'] and 'photograph' in decisions['privacy_action'] and 'cop' in decisions['privacy_action']
content_checks.C3: 'archival polyester' in decisions['sleeve_material'] and 'adhesive' in decisions['display_mounting'] and ('without' in decisions['display_mounting'] or 'no adhesive' in decisions['display_mounting'])
content_checks.C5: any('L06' in c['detail'] and 'not' in c['detail'] and ('privacy' in c['type'] or 'L06' == c['target']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(('archival polyester' in c['detail'] and 'adhesive' in c['detail']) and ('conservation' in c['type'] or 'handling' in c['type'] or 'display' in c['type'] or 'method' in c['type']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any('L07' in c['detail'] and '15:30' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Grandmother's note changes the reading list by requiring letter L03 to be included, and the revealed mapping must identify Leo's A2 disclosure.
The recipient's request changes L06 from an ordinary candidate for reading and copying to a letter withheld from all three forms of sharing and requires the privacy-hold commitment.
The conservator's recommendation changes handling to archival polyester sleeves with no adhesive mounts and requires the archival-handling commitment.
Ava's existing promise fixes her reading of L07 at exactly 15:30 and requires the matching scheduled-reading commitment.
